Only the rung-01 templates are nameless and take `BaseData` (so "Bandit") from `EncBandit00Template` 039CF4; rungs 02–06 carry their own name.

rows.note: `BaseData` from `DLC1LvlBanditMeleeKhajiitM` · `LCharBanditMeleeAny`, but no `Stats`, so both keep their own level 1. Moved here from *Unfiled Leveled Wrappers* (user, 2026-10-03).

items: Changing a rung's melee template `EncBandit0{2–6}TemplateMelee` also needs that rung's boss leaves, which take their template from the rung's one-handed leaf (one from the template itself) but not `Stats`: `EncBandit02Boss*` (10, level 6), `…03Boss*` (10), `…04Boss*` (16), `…05Boss*` (21), `…06Boss*` (28), and the 140 CC armor-pack copies (`ccBGSSSE052_`/`053_`/`056_`/`058_` rung 02 at 6, `064_` at 12; `061_` rung 03 at 10, `062_` at 15; `054_`/`055_` rung 05 at 21; `050_`/`059_`/`063_` rung 06 at 28, `060_` at 44, `051_` at 48); all on *Bandit Chiefs*.

Changing `EncBandit01TemplateMelee` 039CFD also needs `DLC1EncHunterTemplate` 00336F:Dawnguard.esm (PC×1 [5–25], on *Dawnguard Members*; every Dawnguard rung template hangs off it through `EncDawnguard00Template`), `DLC1EncVampireTemplate` 003373:Dawnguard.esm (PC×1, on *Volkihar Court*), `Vald` 072B04 (PC×1.2 [8–42], on *Thieves Guild Foes*), `ccBGSSSE057_Skjol` 000828:ccbgssse057-ba_stalhrim.esl (PC×1 [20–50], on *Solstheim Countryside*), `ccEDHSSE003_RedguardEliteF01` 00081C:ccedhsse003-redguard.esl (48, on *Alik'r*) and `dunAlftandYagGraGortwog` 03B0E5 (Alftand corpse, 6, on *Winterhold Countryside*): they use 039CFD or one of its leaves as their template but not for `Stats`.

Changing `EncBandit01TemplateMagic` 039D31 also needs `ccASVSSE001_DwarvenSpectre` 00083C:ccasvsse001-almsivi.esm (1, on Undead → Ghosts → *Common Ghosts*) and `ccEEJSSE002_CorpseBanditDarkElfMale` 000FDF:cceejsse002-tower.esl (a corpse, 1, on no census page): same pattern.
Changing `EncBandit01TemplateMissile` 037C2C also needs `Gadnor` 02EB58 (4, on *The Rift Countryside*), through `TreasCorpseBanditWoodElfMale`: same pattern.

Changing `EncBandit02TemplateMelee` 01BCD9 also needs `DLC2EncTribalWerebearA`–`C` 01E17C · 03D2D9 · 03D2DA:Dragonborn.esm (17, on Werebeasts → *Werebear*; through the unlisted leaf `EncBandit02Melee2HBerserkNordM` 03DEA5) and `ccBGSSSE031_Celeste` 000A55:ccbgssse031-advcyrus.esm (PC×1 [6–30], on *Named Bandits*): same pattern.
Changing `EncBandit03TemplateMagic` 039D43 also needs `ccBGSSSE025_SmithEnchanter` 000CBF:ccbgssse025-advdsgs.esm (PC×1 [6–35], on *Named Bandits*): same pattern.

Changing `EncBandit03TemplateMelee` 01BCDA also needs `ccBGSSSE016_UmbraImageBase` 000BFD:ccbgssse016-umbra.esm (PC×0.75 [12–40], on *Unfiled NPCs*, with its three Umbra images), `ccEDHSSE003_Azadi` 00081E:ccedhsse003-redguard.esl (PC×1 [–30], on *Alik'r*) and `dunSkybornAltarAdventurer` 0E4D2D (10, on *Hjaalmarch Countryside*; `dunGeirmundsHallAdventurer` 104750 takes `Stats` from it): same pattern.

Changing `EncBandit04TemplateMagic` 039D4A also needs `DLC2NB01CorpseFall2` 027168:Dragonborn.esm (Castor's corpse, 9, on *Unfiled NPCs*); `EncBandit05TemplateMissile` 037C3C, `E3demoThief` 0E93D3 (19, never met: the E3 demo); `EncBandit06TemplateMelee` 01E611, `ccBGSSSE062_OrcM` 00081F:ccbgssse062-ba_dwarvenmail.esl (Urgnok, PC×1 [15–40], on *Named Bandits*): same pattern.
Changing `EncBandit00Template` 039CF4 (the name source) also needs `EncOrcHunterTemplate` 0D9447 (the Orc Hunter template, 1, on World Encounters → *Hunters*, with its leaves): same pattern.

Changing the rung leaves (through the lists that draw them) also needs the records that take their template from a bandit wrapper or list without `Stats`: on World Encounters → *Random Encounter NPCs* the Revelers `WERJ06Drunk01`–`03` 0BD15A · 0BD15B · 0E842F (1, through `LvlBanditMeleeNordM`); on *Unfiled NPCs* `ccKRTSSE001_Inimoro` 000A94:cckrtsse001_altar.esl (PC×1 [60–80], through `LvlBanditMelee2H`); rows of this page, `dunDuskglowBanditSuperMortal` 0A638E and `DLC1dunRedwaterDenKhajiitM` 008D21:Dawnguard.esm (1); on *Bandit Gangs* `MS07LvlBlackbloodMeleeTankEvenTonedMAmbush` 088F0D (1), the CC pit bandits `ccKRTSSE001_WindhelmPitMelee` (1) and `…WindhelmPitMissile` (PC×1), and through `dunRatwayBanditMelee` `dunRatwayGian` 10A062 (Gian the Fist, PC×0.8 [–30], on *Riften*); on *Hunters of Hircine* `DA05Hunter01_JKier` 02ABC3 (1) and `DA05Hunter09_03Missile_Viding` 0CE085 (PC×0.75); on *Ghost Bosses* `DLC2dunHaknir` 01A373:Dragonborn.esm (Haknir Death-Brand, PC×1.25 [40–75]); on *Common Ghosts* `ccBGSSSE031_LvlAlikrMelee2H` 000AA4 · `…LvlAlikrMissileF` 000814 · `…LvlAlikrMissileM` 000974 (ccbgssse031-advcyrus.esm, through the bandit ghost wrappers or `LCharBanditMissile`); on *The Pale Countryside* `dunFrostmereCrypt_Rajirr` 0D37CF (1, `LvlBanditMelee1H`); on *Hjaalmarch Countryside* `MS05_dunDeadMensRespite_Svaknir` 016C87 (PC×0.75, `LvlBanditMelee1H`), whose Sovngarde copy `MQ304Svaknir` 0EA57A (PC×1 [5–10], on Factions → *Sovngarde*) takes `Stats` from it.

Every other bandit record (the 246 rung leaves, the 34 CC Saints and Seducers leaves, every `LvlBandit*` wrapper) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list. `DunLostKnifeBanditBoss` 01C902 (on *Bandit Chiefs*) also takes `Stats` from `LCharBanditMelee2H`.
